usual_baseline: Testing is patchy: 0% [3321], 56% [2983], 56.4% [3099], 89% [3159]. Deficiency is common: 64% insufficient [1159]; only 25% adequate [3159]; 68.18% deficient or inadequate [3321]. Dosing is often wrong: correct dose 21.4%, 41.4% no dose when indicated [1360]. Prophylaxis prescribed 16% [3448], 1 of 10 [3473].
fix_that_works: A pre-populated admission blood form including vitamin D: testing 0% to 86.67%, then 90% sustained in round three [3321]. Psychoeducation and a clinic room poster: supplementation 1 of 10 to 9 of 10 [3473]. A simplified poster and flow chart: prophylaxis 16% to 31% [3448].
fix_that_fails: Policy update and education in a frailty ED changed nothing: 65% to 61% [1803]. In the CAMHS unit, level monitoring stayed at 5 of 10 over three cycles [3473].
consultant_advice: Mostly single-cycle audits across very different settings. The default test on the admission form is the fix that sticks. Audit whether deficient patients get the correct dose and a repeat level, not just whether a test was sent.
